notes.title: Deep Horizon 1.11 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Special thanks to @SgtFopper for bringing this one to our attention.

In our zeal to fix all kinds of pixel glitches in 1.1, we kind of broke the game in some fullscren resolutions.

The new build should address that, let us know how it goes!

notes.title: Deep Horizon 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey guys and gals who purchased and enjoyed Deep Horizon so far.

We already have a small patch to address several little glitches in the game:

1) The "Three-Star Club" achievement will no longer be triggered after just passing the first level. You'll actually have to collect all 72 stars to get it.
2) Big Picture image scaling and alignment issues have been fixed
3) All dialogues will correctly respond to both mouse and gamepad input now.
4) Fixed a render glitch that didn't turn off bubble streams in certain levels
5) Adjusted level end collider sizes based on player feedback
6) Minor bug fixes.

Enjoy the new build!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29262710/3a6547ce459e46506bfb0e67d9696d500b65be77.gif[/img]
